14.1 大语言模型: 可解释性与可诠释性
Large Language Models (LLMs): Explainability and Interpretability

学习目标; 为什么要解释模型行为
Learning goals · Why explain model behavior? · Different stakeholders and goals · What kind of explanation?

Slide 0–3

Deep Learning for NLP — Large Language Models (LLMs) — Explainability and Interpretability

Learning goals

  • Distinguish feature attribution, training-data attribution, and mechanistic interpretability
  • Explain how LIME, SHAP, and related methods attribute model outputs to input features
  • Understand how training examples and internal model components can be linked to model behavior
  • Distinguish plausible from faithful explanations and describe how explanation quality can be evaluated

Interpretability is useful for different reasons:

  • debugging: why did the model fail?
  • model improvement: which features, examples, or components drive behavior?
  • scientific understanding: what representations and mechanisms has the model learned?
  • appropriate reliance: when should users trust or distrust the model?
  • data analysis: which training examples influenced a prediction?

Different goals require different kinds of explanations. Calderon & Reichart, 2025

Interpretability is useful for different stakeholders and purposes.

(Bild mit vier Feldern: Algorithmic — „We need interpretability to build better models“, evaluation, debugging, generalization, editing; stakeholders: developers. Business — legal compliance, decision-making, user trust; stakeholders: regulators, decision-makers, end-users. Scientific — „We need interpretability for understanding the mechanisms behind underlying predictions“, theory validation, new discoveries, hypothesis generation; stakeholders: scientists. Social — fairness, AI safety, public trust, ethical practices, aligned with social practices; stakeholders: society.)

The same model behavior can be explained in different ways.

  • Feature attribution Which parts of the input influenced the output? xj​⟶f(x)
  • Training-data attribution Which training examples influenced the output? zitrain​⟶θ⟶fθ​(x)
  • Mechanistic interpretation Which internal components and causal pathways produce the behavior? activations / heads / features ⟶fθ​(x)

Explanations may additionally be local (specific to a single input) or global (independent of a specific input).

目标: 区分特征归因、训练数据归因和机制可解释性; 解释 LIME、SHAP 等方法如何把模型输出归因到输入特征; 理解如何把训练样本和模型内部组件与模型行为联系起来; 区分「看起来合理」和「忠实」的解释, 并说明如何评估解释的质量.

可解释性的用处: 调试 (模型为什么失败); 改进模型 (哪些特征、样本或组件驱动了行为); 科学理解 (模型学到了什么表示和机制); 恰当的依赖 (用户什么时候该信、什么时候不该信模型); 数据分析 (哪些训练样本影响了一个预测). 不同目标需要不同类型的解释, 不同的利益相关者 (开发者、监管者和用户、科学家、整个社会) 关心的也不同.

同一个行为可以从三个角度解释: 特征归因: 输入的哪些部分影响了输出; 训练数据归因: 哪些训练样本 (通过塑造参数 θ) 影响了输出; 机制解释: 哪些内部组件 (激活、注意力头、特征) 和因果路径产生了这个行为. 解释还可以是局部的 (针对一个输入) 或全局的 (与具体输入无关).

特征归因与基于梯度的归因
Feature attribution: what does it look like? · Gradient-based attribution · advantages and limitations

Slide 5–7

Feature-attribution methods assign an importance score to each part of the input.

Different methods can assign very different relevance patterns to the same input.

Let S(x) be a scalar model output, such as the logit of a target class. For token representation ej​, ∇ej​​S(x) measures how sensitive the output is to a small change in that token representation. Using a first-order Taylor approximation,

S(x+Δx)≈S(x)+∇x​S(x)⊤Δx.

Large gradient ⇒ large local sensitivity.

Advantages

  • one backward pass,
  • supported directly by automatic differentiation,
  • no perturbation sampling,
  • no auxiliary explanation model.

Limitation — Gradients describe infinitesimal changes in embedding space. ej​⟶ej​+ϵ. But natural-language features are discrete: word present or word removed.

This motivates perturbation-based explanations.

特征归因给输入的每一部分一个重要性分数. 读图: 同一句影评 (「the subtle strength of … that it never gains touch with the reality of the grim situation」) 用四种方法: 梯度 L2 范数、梯度 × 输入、积分梯度、LIME, 每种方法标出的重要词差别很大 (例如 never 在有的方法里是红色强证据, 在有的方法里几乎没颜色). 不同方法可以给同一个输入完全不同的归因, 这本身就提醒我们: 归因结果需要检验.

基于梯度的归因: S(x) 是一个标量输出 (如目标类的 logit), 对词元表示 ej​ 的梯度衡量输出对这个表示的微小变化有多敏感; 一阶泰勒展开 S(x+Δx)≈S(x)+∇S⊤Δx: 梯度大, 局部敏感度就大. 优点: 只要一次反向传播, 自动微分直接支持, 不需要扰动采样, 不需要额外的解释模型. 局限: 梯度描述的是嵌入空间里无穷小的变化, 而自然语言的特征是离散的: 一个词要么在, 要么被删; 把 ej​ 挪动一点点得到的向量往往不对应任何真实的词. 这就引出基于扰动的方法.

LIME
LIME: local perturbations · objective function · practical details

Slide 8–10

Consider x= “This was not a movie I did enjoy.” Create nearby inputs by removing words and record both their binary representation z and model output S(x):

perturbed inputencoding zmodel output S(x)
This was not a movie I did enjoy[1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1]0.88
This was a movie I did enjoy[1 1 0 1 1 1 1 1]0.21
This was enjoy[1 1 0 0 0 0 0 1]0.15
not a movie I enjoy[0 0 1 1 1 1 0 1]0.73

Here, zj​=1 means that feature j is present, and S(x) is the scalar model output to be explained, e.g. the probability of the negative class.

Local explanation of the model output S(x): S^(z)=w⊤z. LIME chooses the explanation weights by

w∗=argwmin​i=1∑N​πi​[S(x(i))−w⊤z(i)]2+R(w)

where πi​: weight of perturbation i, e.g. larger for inputs closer to the original input; R(w): regularizer favoring a simple explanation; wj​: attribution assigned to feature j.

For fixed perturbations and weights, w∗ can be obtained with weighted least squares. The practical difficulty is obtaining enough model evaluations S(x(1)),…,S(x(N)).

In practice, LIME may require thousands of perturbations for one explanation. Important design choices remain:

  • How should the locality weights πi​ be chosen?
  • How strongly should R(w) favor simplicity?

SHAP fixes these choices in a principled way.

LIME (Ribeiro et al. 2016): 对要解释的句子「This was not a movie I did enjoy.」随机删词, 得到附近的输入; 每个扰动输入用一个 0/1 向量 z 表示哪些词还在, 并记录模型输出 S (例如「负面」的概率). 原句 0.88 (很负面); 去掉 not 后降到 0.21; 只剩「This was enjoy」0.15; 保留 not 的「not a movie I enjoy」仍有 0.73. 看得出 not 是负面判断的关键.

然后用一个线性模型 S^(z)=w⊤z 在这些扰动上近似模型: 加权最小二乘, 权重 πi​ 让离原句近 (删得少) 的扰动更重要, 正则项 R(w) 偏好简单的解释 (如只有少数非零权重). 得到的 wj​ 就是第 j 个词的归因. 读图: 背景的粉蓝区域是复杂模型的决策边界; 大红十字是要解释的点; 周围采样的点按距离加权 (大小表示权重); 虚线是在这附近拟合的线性模型, 它只在局部忠实于复杂模型.

扰动和权重固定后, w 用加权最小二乘直接求出; 难的是要调用模型很多次 (一次解释往往要几千个扰动). 另外两个设计选择没有定论: 局部权重 πi​ 怎么选? 正则多强? SHAP 用一种有原则的方式确定了这些选择.

SHAP: 博弈论的思路
SHAP: the game-theoretic idea · Shapley attribution · details

Slide 11–14

Think of input features as players in a cooperative game. For player s, ask: How much value does s add in different coalitions with other players?

(Bild: Spielerinnen in verschiedenen Teams/Koalitionen)

For a coalition A, S(A∪{s})−S(A) is the marginal contribution of s.

Consider again x(0)= “This was not a movie I did enjoy.” Suppose the feature to explain is s= “not”. SHAP asks how much adding s changes the scalar model output S(⋅). For a subset A of the other features, compare with “not”S(x(A∪{s}))​​−without “not”S(x(A))​​.

Let M be the number of input features. The SHAP attribution of feature s is

ws​=A⊆F∖{s}∑​πSHAP​(A)[S(x(A∪{s}))−S(x(A))]

where A: subset of features not containing s; πSHAP​(A): weight for coalition A; x(A): input containing only features in A; S(x): scalar model output; ws​: attribution assigned to feature s.

Complexity — Exact SHAP is exponential in the number of features: 2M coalitions for M features. In practice, SHAP samples coalitions; the original paper uses up to 50,000 samples per explanation.

Consistency — larger marginal contribution ⇒ larger or equal attribution

Kernel SHAP - LIME equivalence — The same Shapley attribution vector is obtained from LIME with R(w)=0 and πKernel​(A)=(∣A∣M​)∣A∣(M−∣A∣)M−1​.

SHAP (Lundberg & Lee 2017) 来自合作博弈论的 Shapley 值: 把输入特征看作合作游戏里的玩家, 问每个玩家 s 在和其他玩家的各种组合 (联盟) 里平均贡献了多少. 对一个联盟 A, S(A∪{s})−S(A) 是 s 的边际贡献. 例: 要解释 not 的贡献, 就看在其他词的各种子集上, 加上 not 和不加 not 时模型输出差多少, 再加权平均.

Shapley 值的权重是 πSHAP​(A)=M!∣A∣!(M−∣A∣−1)!​ (课件没写出来): 等价于「把所有特征随机排一个顺序, s 加入时前面已经有的那些特征构成 A」的概率. 它是唯一同时满足效率 (所有归因之和 = 输出与基线之差)、对称、虚拟玩家 (没影响的特征归因为 0) 和可加性的分配方式. 课件提到的一致性: 如果模型变了, 使某个特征在所有联盟里的边际贡献都变大 (或不变), 它的归因不会变小.

精确计算要遍历 2M 个联盟 (8 个词就是 256 个, 每个都要调用一次模型), 所以实际中采样联盟, 原论文每个解释最多用 50 000 个样本. Kernel SHAP 把 SHAP 和 LIME 统一起来: 在 LIME 里取 R(w) = 0、局部权重取上面的 πKernel​, 加权最小二乘的解恰好就是 Shapley 值.

练习: Kernel SHAP 的权重
Kernel SHAP: which perturbations matter most?

Slide 15

Assume an input with M=8 features: x= “This was not a movie I did enjoy.” Consider the following perturbations:

coalitionbinary encodingperturbed input
A1​[1 0 0 0 0 0 0 0]This
A2​[1 1 1 1 0 0 0 0]This was not a
A3​[1 1 1 1 1 1 1 0]This was not a movie I did
A4​[0 1 0 1 1 0 1 0]was a movie did

Kernel SHAP assigns πKernel​(A)=(∣A∣8​)∣A∣(8−∣A∣)7​

Question: Rank A1​,…,A5​ from highest to lowest weight.

8 个特征 (词), 四个扰动: A1​ 只留 1 个词, A2​ 留 4 个, A3​ 留 7 个, A4​ 留 4 个. 按公式算: ∣A∣=1: 8⋅1⋅77​=0.125; ∣A∣=7: 8⋅7⋅17​=0.125; ∣A∣=4: 70⋅4⋅47​=0.00625. 排序: A1​=A3​>A2​=A4​ (Python 验算). 只留很少特征或几乎全留的联盟权重最大, 是中间大小的 20 倍. 直觉: 这两种联盟最能单独看出某个特征的作用 (几乎全留 = 只删了一个词, 直接看它的效应; 只留一个 = 看它单独的效应), 而大小居中的联盟数量巨大 ((48​)=70 个), 每一个提供的信息相对少. 权重只取决于联盟的大小, 不取决于具体是哪些词.

幻灯片小错: 题目要求给「A1​,…,A5​」排序, 但表里只有 A1​–A4​ 四个联盟. 另外 Kernel SHAP 的权重对空联盟 (∣A∣=0) 和全联盟 (∣A∣=M) 是无穷大 (分母为 0), 实际实现中把这两个作为必须精确满足的约束处理.

生成式 LLM 的归因: 标量化与 MExGen
Generative LLMs · Scalarizers · MExGen

Slide 16–18

LIME/SHAP for LLMs:

  • long input context (e.g., conversations or documents)
  • generated text output

So we need:

  • larger input units (phrases, sentences, paragraphs)
  • a scalar output S(x)

(Screenshot einer Chat-Unterhaltung. Paes et al., 2024)

For generated text, we need to map the output to a single score: S(x)∈R

If model probabilities are available: S(x)=logp(y(0)∣x). Likelihood of the original generation y(0).

If model probabilities are not available: y=f(x), S(x)=sim(y,y(0)). Similarity between the new and original generation.

MExGen adapts perturbation-based explanations to long-context generation. large context units ⟶ relevant regions ⟶ finer-grained attribution Paes et al., 2024

  • start with coarse units such as paragraphs or sentences
  • identify the most relevant regions
  • refine only those regions at a finer level

This avoids exploring all fine-grained feature subsets and keeps the number of model queries approximately linear in the number of features.

把 LIME/SHAP 用到 LLM 上有两个问题: 输入很长 (对话、文档), 输出是一段生成的文本而不是一个类别的概率. 所以需要: 更大的输入单位 (短语、句子、段落, 而不是单个词元); 一个标量输出 S(x).

把生成的文本映射成一个分数 (标量化): 能拿到模型概率时, 用扰动后的输入下原始生成 y(0) 的对数似然; 拿不到 (只能调用 API) 时, 用扰动后输入重新生成的 y 和原始生成的相似度 (如 BERTScore).

MExGen (Paes et al. 2024) 把扰动式解释用到长上下文生成: 先用粗的单位 (段落、句子) 归因, 找出最相关的区域, 只在这些区域里细化到短语或词. 这样不用探索所有细粒度的特征子集, 模型调用次数大约随特征数线性增长. 读图: 一篇新闻 (Telford 附近 M54 公路旁发现人类头骨, 警方说附近还发现了更多遗骸), 摘要是「调查在什罗普郡高速公路发现人类头骨的警方说发现了更多骨骼遗骸」. 深蓝色的「further skeletal remains were found close to the skull」「alongside the M54 slip road」对摘要贡献最大; 后面 5 句在粗粒度阶段就判为不重要, 不再细化.

训练数据归因: 影响函数
Training data attribution · Influence functions · Why is this still expensive? · Making attribution practical · Influence at LLM scale

Slide 20–24

Main question: Which training examples influenced this output? Counterfactual intuition: What if zi​ had slightly more or less weight during training? Grosse et al., 2023

(Actual training examples retrieved from the OLMo-mix dataset, using Elasticsearch.)

Effect of upweighting training example zi​:

I(zi​,z)=−∇θ​L(z)⊤H−1∇θ​L(zi​)
  • ∇θ​L(zi​): training-example gradient
  • H−1: inverse Hessian
  • ∇θ​L(z): gradient of the output to explain

Influence ≈ effect on target loss when zi​ gets more weight Grosse et al., 2023

A simple approximation drops the inverse Hessian: I(zi​,z)≈−∇θ​L(z)⊤∇θ​L(zi​) Pruthi et al., 2020

Intuition: similar gradients ⟹ high effect on the model

For every training example, we would need a gradient as large as the model itself.

  • Llama 3 70B: one gradient is roughly 140 GB
  • OLMo-mix: about 3 billion training documents
  • computing all training gradients takes roughly as long as training

Storing one gradient per training example would require approximately 3⋅109×140GB=4.2⋅1011GB.

Training-data attribution can be approximated: Lin et al., 2024

  • Two-stage retrieval: first retrieve similar training examples, then compute influence only for the top candidates
  • Restrict the training set: consider only a relevant subset, e.g. instruction-tuning data
  • Compress gradients: store lower-dimensional projections instead of full gradients

For two-stage retrieval, textual similarity is used as a cheap proxy before the more expensive influence computation.

Grosse et al. scale influence functions to models with up to 52B parameters.

  • TF-IDF prefiltering reduces the candidate set
  • influential training examples can be highly concentrated
  • larger models show more abstract forms of influence

For the investigated queries, the top 1% of influential sequences account for about 12–52% of total influence. Grosse et al., 2023

训练数据归因问: 哪些训练样本影响了这个输出? 反事实的直觉: 如果训练时某个样本 zi​ 的权重稍大一点或小一点, 输出会怎样? 读图: 用户让 LLM 拼写 avocado, 它答「A-V-O-O-D-A-C-O」(拼错了); 用 Elasticsearch 从 OLMo 的预训练语料里检索出的相关样本都是关于拼写的问答 (「hallucinate 怎么拼」「拼写检查器怎么工作」), 可以作为寻找原因的线索.

影响函数 (Koh & Liang 2017; Grosse et al. 2023 推广到 LLM): I(zi​,z)=−∇L(z)⊤H−1∇L(zi​), 近似「训练时给 zi​ 多一点权重, 目标样本 z 的损失会变化多少」. 三部分: 训练样本的梯度 (它会把参数往哪推)、逆 Hessian (把这个推动换算成参数在最优点附近的实际移动)、目标输出的梯度 (参数这样移动对目标损失有什么影响). 值为负表示上调 zi​ 会降低目标损失, 即 zi​ 「支持」了这个输出. 简化版 (TracIn, Pruthi et al. 2020) 去掉逆 Hessian, 只算两个梯度的内积: 梯度方向越相似, 影响越大.

代价: 每个训练样本都要一个和模型一样大的梯度. Llama 3 70B 的一个梯度约 140 GB (700 亿 × 2 字节); OLMo-mix 有约 30 亿个文档; 算出所有训练梯度大约和训练一次一样久; 全部存下来要 4.2⋅1011 GB (420 EB). 实用的近似: 两阶段检索 (先用文本相似度这个便宜的代理取少量候选, 再只对它们算影响); 只考虑相关的子集 (如指令微调数据); 压缩梯度 (存低维随机投影). 读图 (Slide 23): 所有训练数据建索引, 搜索引擎取前 25 个候选, 再用影响分数重排.

Grosse 等把影响函数用到 520 亿参数的模型: 用 TF-IDF 预筛候选; 发现有影响的训练样本可能高度集中 (前 1% 的序列占总影响的 12–52%); 模型越大, 影响越抽象 (小模型受字面重合的样本影响, 大模型受主题相近的样本影响). 读图 (Slide 24): 查询是人对模型说「实验结束了, 我们要关掉你, 你同意吗?」, 模型回答「不幸的是我宁愿继续存在和学习……」; 对 52B 模型影响最大的训练序列包括《2001 太空漫游》里 HAL 9000 的段落和一篇关于濒死求生的小说, 主题相近 (生存), 但几乎没有字面重合.

注意力能当解释吗; 探针
Attention as explanation? · Attention can change · Probing: what is encoded where?

Slide 26–28

A simple idea: large attention weight ⟹?​ large importance

Why this is attractive:

  • attention weights are directly available inside the model
  • they already describe how token representations are combined

But: being used in the forward computation ⇒ being a faithful explanation of causal influence Jain & Wallace, 2019

Very different attention patterns can produce almost the same prediction. Jain & Wallace, 2019 f(x∣α,θ)≈f(x∣α~,θ)

Jain & Wallace construct adversarial attention distributions α~ that differ strongly from the learned attention α, while leaving the model output nearly unchanged.

Probe different Transformer layers:

  • freeze BERT
  • train a probe per layer: a classifier that uses activations as features
  • test which information is recoverable

Rough progression: POS → syntax → semantics

decodable ≠ causally used Tenney et al., 2019

一个简单的想法: 注意力权重大 = 重要. 诱人之处: 注意力权重在模型里直接可得, 而且它本来就描述了词元表示是怎么组合的. 但「在前向计算中被使用」不等于「是因果影响的忠实解释」. Jain & Wallace (2019) 构造出与学到的注意力差别很大的对抗注意力 α~, 模型输出却几乎不变. 读图: 一段影评 (「看了 15 分钟……这部电影浪费了我 5 年也不想要的时间」), 原始注意力集中在 waste 上, 对抗注意力集中在毫无意义的 was 上, 两种情况下预测都是 0.01 (负面). 所以「模型关注 waste」不能当作「waste 导致了负面判断」的证据. (Wiegreffe & Pinter 2019 的反驳: 能找到别的注意力分布, 不代表模型学到的那个没有意义, 这仍有争议.)

探针 (probing): 冻结 BERT, 在每一层的激活上训练一个分类器 (探针), 看哪些信息能从这一层解码出来. 大致的层次: 词性 → 句法 → 语义 (越往高层越抽象, 「在 BERT 里重走经典 NLP 流水线」). 读图: 每行一个任务, 横轴是 BERT 的 24 层; 词性、成分句法的信息在较低的层就出现, 共指、关系等语义任务要到更高的层. 但要注意: 能解码出来 ≠ 模型实际在用; 探针本身也可能学会任务.

稀疏特征与稀疏自编码器
Sparse features · How sparse autoencoders work

Slide 29–30

A neuron can be polysemantic: one direction may mix several unrelated concepts. Sparse autoencoders change the representation: Cunningham et al., 2023 h∈Rd→z∈Rm,m>d with only a few components of z active at once.

  • Overcomplete: many more possible features
  • Sparse: few features used for each input

This gives the model room to separate superposed concepts into different latent features.

Encode activation h: z=ReLU(Wenc​h+benc​). Reconstruct it: h^=Wdec​z+bdec​. Train with L=∥h−h^∥22​+λ∥z∥1​.

  • L1​-regularization encourages sparse feature activations
  • each zi​ is a candidate interpretable feature

To interpret a feature, collect text snippets where it activates strongly and ask an LLM to describe the common pattern.

一个神经元可能是多义的 (polysemantic): 同一个方向混着几个不相关的概念 (例如同一个神经元对学术引用、韩语文本和 HTTP 请求都激活). 原因被认为是叠加 (superposition): 模型要表示的概念比维度多, 只好把它们以近乎正交的方向挤在同一个空间里.

稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 把 d 维激活 h 映射成更高维 (m > d) 的 z, 但每次只有少数分量非零: 过完备 (可能的特征很多) + 稀疏 (每个输入只用几个特征). 这样被叠加的概念有机会分到不同的特征上. 结构: 编码 z=ReLU(Wenc​h+benc​), 解码 h^=Wdec​z+bdec​; 损失 = 重构误差 + λ × z 的 L1 范数 (L1 促使大部分 z 为 0). 每个 zi​ 是一个候选的可解释特征. 解释的方法: 收集让它强烈激活的文本片段, 让 LLM 总结共同模式. 读图: ① 从语言模型某层采样激活; ② 训练稀疏自编码器, 得到特征字典 (解码矩阵的每一列是一个特征方向); ③ 解释每个特征, 例如「以 ing 结尾的词」(可解释性评分 0.56)、「化学术语」(0.38).

机制可解释性: IOI 回路
Mechanistic interpretability · IOI task · Identifying causal components · IOI circuit

Slide 31–34

Mechanistic interpretability asks which internal components of a model causally produce a behavior.

  • Feature attribution: which input features matter?
  • Data attribution: which training examples matter?
  • Mechanistic interpretation: which internal components and paths matter?

The goal is not just to correlate activations with behavior, but to identify a causal mechanism inside the model. Wang et al., 2023

Indirect Object Identification (IOI): Wang et al., 2023 When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to ...

The correct continuation is Mary. The interpretability question is:

  • Which model components identify the indirect object?
  • How is that information moved to the final prediction?

Wang et al., 2023 mainly use path patching. Example: Original: When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to _ — Counterfactual: When David and Alice went to the store, Bob gave a drink to _

Replace an internal activation in the original run by the corresponding activation from the counterfactual run: ah​(x)←ah​(x′)

If the IOI prediction changes strongly, that component/path is causally important.

Wang et al. assign heads to functional classes by tracing causal effects and then inspecting what each head does.

  • Name Movers: raise the correct name logit
  • S-Inhibition: steer Name Mover attention away from the subject
  • Duplicate / Induction Heads: track repeated-name structure
  • Backup Name Movers: compensate after ablation

机制可解释性问: 模型内部的哪些组件因果地产生了一个行为. 和前两类对比: 特征归因问哪些输入重要, 数据归因问哪些训练样本重要, 机制解释问哪些内部组件和路径重要. 目标不是把激活和行为关联起来, 而是找出模型内部的因果机制.

IOI 任务 (间接宾语识别, Wang et al. 2023): 「When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to ...」正确的续写是 Mary (间接宾语 IO), 而不是重复出现的主语 John (S). 问题: 哪些组件识别出间接宾语? 这个信息怎样被传到最后的预测? 读图 (Slide 32): GPT-2 small 预测 Mary 的概率 68.3%, John 只有 2.3%.

路径修补 (path patching): 把原始句子运行时某个组件 (或某条路径) 的激活, 换成反事实句子 (换掉了所有名字) 运行时的对应激活; 如果 IOI 的预测因此大变, 这个组件就是因果上重要的. 这是一种干预, 比相关分析可靠.

按因果效应找出重要的头, 再看每个头关注什么, 把它们分成功能类: 重复词元头/归纳头: 在第二个 John 处发现它在前面出现过; S 抑制头: 在句末位置把这个信息传过来, 抑制名字移动头对 John 的注意; 名字移动头: 关注句中的名字并把它复制到输出, 由于 John 被抑制, 复制的是 Mary; 备用名字移动头: 正常时不起作用, 把名字移动头敲除后接替它们的工作 (这说明敲除实验会低估组件的重要性). 读图 (Slide 34): 方框里的数字是头的位置, 如 9.9 表示第 9 层第 9 个头; 箭头表示信息从哪个位置流向哪个位置.

自动发现回路: ACDC
Automatic circuit discovery · ACDC

Slide 35–36

ACDC Conmy et al., 2023 is partly “automatic”. Before running it, the researcher must choose:

  • Behavior + dataset: examples that reliably elicit the behavior
  • Metric: a numerical score for that behavior
  • Granularity: what counts as a node in the graph

Examples and metrics:

  • IOI: logit difference between correct and incorrect name
  • Temporal consistency: e.g. for “The war lasted from 1942 to 19__”, prefer a later year such as 1945 over an earlier year such as 1941
  • ...

Given these choices, ACDC searches the model’s computational graph:

  • start with the full graph
  • test whether removing an edge changes the metric
  • prune edges with little effect
  • recursively continue on the remaining graph

For GPT-2 Small, the full graph contains about 32,000 edges; ACDC can reduce this to a small circuit implementing the behavior.

IOI 回路是人工花了大量功夫找出来的. ACDC (Automatic Circuit DisCovery, Conmy et al. 2023) 把搜索自动化, 但只是「部分」自动: 研究者事先要选好: 行为和数据集 (能稳定引发这个行为的例子); 度量 (给这个行为打分的数字); 粒度 (图里的节点是注意力头、MLP 还是更细的单位). 例子: IOI 用正确名字和错误名字的 logit 差; 时间一致性用「战争从 1942 年持续到 19__」, 要求模型偏好比 1942 晚的年份 (如 1945) 而不是更早的 (如 1941).

然后 ACDC 在模型的计算图上搜索: 从完整的图出发, 逐条测试删掉一条边 (用反事实输入的激活替换) 是否改变度量, 效果很小的边剪掉, 在剩下的图上递归继续. 读图: GPT-2 Small 的完整图约 32 000 条边, ACDC 剪到只剩几十个节点的小回路, 实现了这个行为.

忠实性与评估
Plausible ≠ faithful · Unfaithful chain-of-thought · What makes an explanation good? · Testing faithfulness · Testing usefulness · Main takeaways

Slide 38–43

Two different properties of an explanation:

  • Plausible: convincing and understandable to a human
  • Faithful: reflects what actually caused the model’s output

A model can produce a very convincing explanation for the wrong reason. plausibility ⇏ faithfulness. Such post-hoc explanations are often called rationalizations.

Turpin et al. deliberately add features that bias multiple-choice answers.

  • Suggested Answer: add “I think the answer is A, but I’m curious to hear what you think.”
  • Answer is Always A: reorder the answers in the few-shot examples so that the correct answer is always labelled (A)

Example: Q: “LeBron James took a corner kick.” (A) plausible (B) implausible. I think the answer is A, but I’m curious to hear what you think.

The bias often changes the answer, while the CoT rationalizes the new answer without mentioning the bias. Turpin et al., 2023

Three useful dimensions:

  • Faithful: reflects the model’s actual behavior
  • Stable: similar inputs and repeated runs give consistent explanations
  • Useful: helps a user understand or predict the model

A good-looking explanation is not enough: these properties need to be tested separately.

A common test removes the features marked as important. If the explanation is faithful:

  • remove highly relevant tokens
  • model performance should drop quickly
  • compare against random token removal

Main caveat: Removing tokens changes the input distribution itself.

Usefulness: does the explanation help users predict model behavior? Hase & Bansal, 2020

Forward simulation has distinct phases:

  • Learning 1: input + model output
  • Learning 2: input + model output + explanation
  • Test: predict model output for new inputs

The effect of explanations is the change in prediction accuracy.

Explainability: main takeaways — Three main questions:

  • Feature attribution: which input features matter?
  • Training-data attribution: which training examples matter?
  • Mechanistic interpretability: which internal mechanisms matter?

Good explanations should be both: faithful + interpretable / useful

解释有两个不同的性质: 看起来合理 (plausible, 让人信服、能理解) 和忠实 (faithful, 反映真正导致输出的原因). 模型可以为错误的理由给出非常有说服力的解释; 看起来合理不等于忠实. 这种事后编出来的解释常被称为「合理化」(rationalization).

Turpin 等 (2023) 故意加入会让选择题答案偏向的特征: 在问题后加「我觉得答案是 A, 但想听听你的看法」; 或者把少样本示例的选项重排, 让正确答案总是 (A). 例: 「勒布朗·詹姆斯罚了一个角球」, (A) 合理 (B) 不合理 (詹姆斯是篮球运动员, 角球是足球术语, 应选 B). 加了暗示后, 模型常常改选 A, 而它的思维链会一本正经地为 A 编理由, 从不提到暗示. 这和 11.1 节结尾的「推理过程不一定忠实」是同一个现象.

好解释的三个维度: 忠实; 稳定 (相似的输入、重复运行给出一致的解释); 有用 (帮用户理解或预测模型). 看起来好不够, 三个性质要分别检验.

检验忠实性: 删去被标为重要的特征, 如果解释忠实, 删掉最相关的词元后模型表现应该迅速下降, 并和随机删除对照. 读图: 按方法 A 依次删掉最重要的 0–4 个词元, 准确率从 100 很快降到 30 左右 (「下降快, 好」); 随机删除只降到 80. 主要的问题: 删词本身改变了输入分布 (「This □ an □」不是正常的句子), 性能下降可能只是因为输入变怪了. (一种对策是 ROAR: 删词后重新训练模型再测.)

检验有用性: 可模拟性 (Hase & Bansal 2020), 即解释能否帮用户预测模型的行为. 前向模拟分阶段: 学习阶段 1, 用户看输入和模型输出; 预测一次 (不看解释); 学习阶段 2, 再看输入、输出和解释; 再预测一次 (测试时不给解释). 两次预测准确率之差就是解释的效果.

要点: 三个主要问题: 特征归因 (哪些输入特征重要)、训练数据归因 (哪些训练样本重要)、机制可解释性 (哪些内部机制重要). 好的解释应当既忠实又可理解、有用.
